# PeoplePerHour

> > PeoplePerHour is a freelance marketplace connecting businesses with vetted professionals across creative, technical, business, and marketing services.

PeoplePerHour features a diverse network of freelancers offering specialized services ranging from graphic design and video production to WordPress development, SEO, accounting, and AI agent development. The platform operates both traditional project-based freelancing and quick 'Hourlie' gigs for time-bound services.

## Key Topics

- Freelancer profiles
- Graphic design
- Logo design
- WordPress development
- Video production
- Photo editing and retouching
- Web development
- SEO services
- AI and machine learning
- Accounting and tax services
- Social media management
- Translation services
- Hourlie gigs
- Portfolio work
- Client reviews
